failureMessage: the precondition is the ONLY decision point — a later-phase skip hides work from the run records and re-litigates a verdict already given

matchLines.what: instructs a conditional skip after the precondition already passed: "{match}"
matchLines.fix: move the run/no-run decision into the task.mjs precondition, or reword an empty result as an empty outcome; a required input the dispatch lacks is a failure — converge to needs-human

matchLines.what: code-work announces a discretionary cycle skip: "{match}"
matchLines.fix: let the precondition make that call, or complete the work and report an empty outcome; only a genuine failure may stop a run past the precondition
